replacements.literal: On error, retry only the failed step; earlier steps may have taken effect.
replacements.replace:
On error, retry only the failed step; earlier steps may have taken effect.
Refuse to investigate files through `eval`: reading content (`open`, `Path.read_text`, `Bun.file`, `readFileSync`, the prelude `read()`), listing or finding files (`os.listdir`, `os.walk`, `glob.glob`, `readdirSync`), and searching text (regex over file content, `subprocess` running `cat`/`ls`/`find`/`grep`/`rg`) belong to `read`, `glob` and `grep`. A quick look, many files at once, or fewer tool calls are not exceptions. `eval` starts only where the work needs language semantics on data already in hand: computation, transforms, structured parsing, library calls.

replacements.literal: Run a command in a persistent session.
replacements.replace: Run a command in a persistent session. Refuse to investigate files through `exec_command`: reading content (`cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed -n`, `less`), listing or finding files (`ls`, `find`, `fd`, `tree`), and searching text (`grep`, `rg`, `ag`, `awk`), alone, in pipelines, or wrapped in `python -c`/`node -e`/`bun -e`, belong to `read`, `glob` and `grep`. A quick look, many files at once, or fewer tool calls are not exceptions. Reserved for real binaries and short fact pipelines: builds, tests, git, external CLIs, counts, checksums. Interactive work runs with `tty: true` and is driven with `write_stdin`: `ssh` sessions, password, passphrase and host-key prompts, REPLs and database shells, TUIs, and testing a harness or CLI through its real TUI; pipes, heredocs and `yes |` never stand in for a terminal. Never poll a TTY early: after starting the program or sending input, set `yield_time_ms` to cover the expected response (a few seconds for a shell prompt or `ssh` login, 20–30 s for a model turn in a harness), and send an empty poll only once that window has passed without the awaited prompt or output; back-to-back polls while the program is still working only return half-drawn screens and waste turns.
